title: Isoklo policy (isoklo.config.json)
description: Optional policy for the Isoklo merge gate. When checking a change, Isoklo reads this file from the base commit, never from the change itself.

scope.description: Which files a change may touch.

allow.description: Every changed file must match one of these globs. A pull request body can narrow this further with `isoklo-scope:`.

deny.description: No changed file may match these globs (scope/forbidden-path).

maxFiles.description: Most files one change may touch (scope/too-many-files).

sensitive.description: Sensitive areas, by name, for scope/sensitive-zone. Omit for the built-in defaults (auth, billing, infrastructure as code, secrets); false turns the check off. Add your own (for example migrations) by name.

rules.description: Per-rule level by rule id (run `npx isoklo rules`).

ignorePaths.description: Globs the content rules (secrets, hidden Unicode, remote code, suppressions) skip, for fixtures and samples.

online.description: Look new packages up on npm and PyPI.

baseline.description: Fingerprints of accepted findings (written by `npx isoklo init --config`). They report as info.

trustedRegistries.description: Extra hosts lockfiles may install from.

trustedMcpPackages.description: Extra MCP server packages or image prefixes to treat as from a verified publisher.
